description:
Proposed external alterations to first/second-floor maisonette at 47 Haydons Road, SW19 1HG comprising:

Roof windows (front roof slope): installation of two roof windows, each 600 × 1000 mm, set flush with the roof covering with tile flashing kits and installed to manufacturer guidance and Building Regulations; no change to ridge or eaves height. A further high-level roof window in back roof slope above existing kitchen 1210 × 1210 mm positioned to avoid overlooking, installed flush with roof.

Side elevation air-conditioning equipment: installation of two external condensers – Mitsubishi MUZ-AY20VG (or equivalent) mounted vertically on anti-vibration brackets; maximum sound pressure 48 dB(A) @1 m per unit; nearest noise-sensitive receptor is the neighbour’s kitchen window at ~4.5 m, where the combined sound level is approx. 39 dB(A). Condensate discharges to the existing SVP with 1:80 fall; refrigerant/controls via 125 mm Ø builderswork opening made good weathertight.

Rear access improvements: existing rear window opening widened and lowered to floor level and fitted with a glazed door set to access a new external steel staircase to the rear garden. Stair and landing designed in accordance with Approved Document K with an approx. 1100 × 1100 mm landing pad founded on a 150 mm RC slab on 100 mm compacted Type 1. The stair/landing is offset to avoid blocking light to the ground-floor flat bathroom window. Non-vision (frosted) privacy panels are provided to both sides at the top landing to minimise overlooking compared with existing. Supporting structure spans the shared walkway, retaining adequate access for bicycle movement to the neighbouring garden as requested by the freeholders. External finishes galvanised/painted steel (colour to be agreed).

Ancillary penetrations (services & ventilation): provide 125 mm Ø builderswork opening for the bathroom extract terminal ducted to the external wall with a low-profile grille in compliance with Part F, and 125 mm Ø opening for soil/waste connection to existing drainage in compliance with Part H. Making good to match adjacent materials.

General: works limited to the subject maisonette; ground-floor flat – no works. Where noted “Existing eaves wall taken back by 470 mm” this relates to internal eaves adjustment (see MX25015-MEX-SK-S-0001) and does not alter the external roof form.

Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
Drawing no: 2025 OS 100042766 (Site Location Plan) Dated 01-Sep-2025  
Drawing no. 02-P100/Rev4 (EXISTING LOFT LEVEL PLAN02, EXISTING FIRST FLOOR PLAN 01, 7 EXISTING FRONT PERSPECTIVE VIEW EXISTING FRONT ELEVATION PLAN, PROPOSED FRONT PERSPECTIVE VIEW EXISTING SIDE ELEVATION PLAN ,14 EXISTING BACK PERSPECTIVE VIEW, 6 EXISTING BACK ELEVATION PLAN, PROPOSED LOFT LEVEL PLAN 02 , 10 PROPOSED FIRST FLOOR PLAN  10 PROPOSED FRONT ELEVATION PLAN, PROPOSED SIDE ELEVATION PLAN,11 , PROPOSED  REAR ELEVATION PLAN12 , 10 PROPOSED FRONT PERSPECTIVE VIEW PLAN 13, 15 PROPOSED BACK PERSPECTIVE VIEW PLAN ,PROPOSED REAR PERSPECTIVE VIEW PLAN And  Non-Vision Panels Extended, Stairs
Stepped Away From Boundary) Dated 23-10-2025
Drawing no. SK-S-0001/RevP01 (Proposed Loft Plan) Dated 30/07/25.   
Design & Amenity Statement Dated 30-08-20250
 
Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Noise Levels - Expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) LAeq (15 minutes), from the new mechanical plant/air conditioning shall not exceed LA90-10bB at the boundary with any residential property.,The Applicant would  expeced  to comply with the principles set out in the Acoustic Technical  Report, submitted with the application in order to protect residents from adverse noise levels.
 
Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy D14 of the London Plan 2021 and policy D12.1 of the Local Plan 2024.and the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) 2024 
Condition : 5 - Screening - The screening or enclosure to the balcony as shown on the approved plans shall be obscurely glazed and implemented before the development is first occupied and retained permanently thereafter.
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE
The London Borough of Merton's Environmental Health Service set out that normally the hours for noisy works are:
8am - 6pm on Monday to Friday
8am - 1pm on Saturday
no noisy works on Sundays and Bank Holidays
Further details can be found here: https://www.merton.gov.uk/communities-and-neighbourhoods/noise-nuisance/report-nuisance/building-noise
Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay..
